title: Smoke Induction (ORIGINAL)
description: I'm excited to share with you this fun ASMR Induction I played around with while I was in the middle of recording files... To bring you into just the right headspace for hypnosis, I have brought along a little extra something today. A special blend made to mess with your mind. And if you're familiar with my triggers, and my deep breathing techniques, then it should hit you all the more... potently ;). All you have to do is pull up a seat and let me do a thorough inspection of you before we start. Instructions There is no need to for you to actually inhale smoke in this file. It's perfectly acceptable to breath deeply, and just as natural in getting you a little happily tranced and hazy in there — under my influence — under my control. But it's still important that there's a fresh flow of air into your surroundings.
author: Mistress Shibby
